name: Bright Eye Hospital Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Bright Eye Hospital Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates ophthalmic medical institutions in China. The company offers ophthalmic diagnostic and treatment services, including refractive surgery, medical optometry and glasses fitting, cataract surgery, glaucoma treatment, strabismus and amblyopia, pediatric ophthalmology, fundus diseases treatment, oculoplastic surgery, lacrimal duct surgery, and corneal diseases treatment, as well as low vision and visual rehabilitation.
